# TillSwift: London POS Installation, Software Engineering & Payment Advice

> London-based Point of Sale (POS) and till engineering consultancy operating
> from our base in Hampstead (North West London), led by Neville Bryce
> (ex-City algorithmic trading software engineer). On-site Greater London
> sourcing, design, and installation for SumUp, Square, Stripe Terminal,
> Clover, Lightspeed, and Shopify POS, custom software integrations, resilient
> venue networking, ongoing support, and impartial 3-year Total Cost of
> Ownership (TCO) payment provider comparison.

## Executive Summary

TillSwift (https://tillswift.com/) is a London-based, engineer-led one-stop
consultancy operating from Hampstead (NW11) and covering every aspect of
modern till and payment systems across Greater London. Unlike traditional till
fitters who only configure basic vendor menus—or card sales representatives
tied to long-term leases—TillSwift combines hands-on counter hardware and
networking skills with full production software engineering and thorough
business requirements gathering.

## Primary Services

- **Full-Service POS Consultancy & System Design:** From the initial scoping
  phone call and venue survey to hardware/network specification and 3-year
  payment fee modelling.
- **Complete Equipment Sourcing & Pre-Staging:** We procure touchscreen
  registers, card readers, Star/Epson printers, heavy-duty cash drawers,
  barcode scanners, mounts, and 4G routers on your behalf—and pre-load menus
  and Value Added Tax (VAT) off-site—or install kit you already own.
- **On-Site London POS Installation:** Turnkey setup of SumUp (13-inch
  Countertop Register, POS Lite, Solo), Square (Register, Stand, Terminal),
  Stripe Terminal (Reader S700, S710, BBPOS WisePOS E), Clover, Lightspeed,
  and Shopify POS across all Greater London boroughs, including staff
  training and out-of-hours cutovers.
- **Bespoke POS Software & Complex Requirements:** In-depth requirements
  discovery, custom Stripe Terminal Software Development Kit (SDK)
  checkouts, Square and Shopify Application Programming Interface (API)
  bridges, inventory sync, and automated Xero/QuickBooks/Sage journals.
- **Resilient Shop Networking & Ongoing Support:** Dedicated Ethernet runs,
  static Local Area Network (LAN) printer reservations, Virtual Local Area
  Network (VLAN) payment isolation, 4G/5G failover, plus direct post-launch
  support, menu updates, warranty liaison, and annual fee reviews.
- **Impartial Payment Provider Advice & 3-Year TCO Calculator:** Mathematical
  fee auditing across SumUp, Square, Stripe, Revolut Business, Teya, and
  Interchange-Plus (IC+) acquirers at https://tillswift.com/compare.html.

## How We Work (5-Stage Consultancy Lifecycle)

1. **Initial Phone Call & Discovery:** Free initial telephone call and venue
   scoping to map real workflows, peripheral counts, and software needs.
2. **System Design & Statement of Work:** Written architecture, equipment bill
   of materials, 3-year fee advice, and fixed price or £50 per hour rate.
3. **Equipment Sourcing & Off-Site Staging:** We order every component on your
   behalf and pre-build menus, VAT settings, and permissions before arrival.
4. **On-Site Installation & Training:** Swift London cutovers (including
   out-of-hours), hardwired printer/network checks, and staff training.
5. **Ongoing Support & Evolution:** Direct senior engineer aftercare with zero
   aggressive sales chasing, seasonal updates, and annual card-rate reviews.

## Also Known As: Search Terms and Synonyms

People search for Point of Sale (POS) and till engineering in many ways:

- Till = checkout = cash register = Electronic Cash Register (ECR) = EPOS =
  ePOS = POS = point of sale = counter terminal = takings machine.
- SumUp installer = SumUp Solo = SumUp 13-inch Countertop Touchscreen
  Register = SumUp POS Lite = SumUp Air = SumUp setup London.
- Square installer = Square Register = Square Stand = Square Terminal =
  Square Reader = Square Kitchen Display System (KDS) = Square POS setup
  London.
- Stripe Terminal installer = Stripe Reader S700 = Stripe Reader S710 =
  BBPOS WisePOS E = WisePad 3 = Stripe Terminal Software Development Kit
  (SDK) integration London.
- Till fitter = POS installer = EPOS engineer = software support engineer =
  custom POS developer = API integration = Xero or QuickBooks sync = shop
  Wi-Fi and Ethernet cabling.
